champion_v2.what: CHAMPION V2 — the board's pick product: the champion's own live totals engine (unchanged) + V4 serving discipline (+EV/vig gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers by the champion's own edge size, nightly grading). PREGAME TOTALS ONLY.
champion_v2.star_basis: STAR SYSTEM v3 (Leon, 2026-07-07): RATE EVERY GAME — every row carries 1-5 stars, an always-populated lean={side,line}, a continuous 0-5 score, and playable=(stars>=2). 1 star = WE WOULD PASS (the lean is still stated, clearly labeled Pass): rows that fail the +EV gate at the real latest per-side price, and the toxic tail |edge| >= 0.065 — measured ANTI-signal on the champion's own graded 2022-2026 history (33-43, hit 43.4%, ROI -17.1%; 947 graded picks, 892 decided, day-clustered 95% bootstrap CIs — v4/serve/STAR_CALIBRATION.md). Playable tiers are the MEASURED divergence bands: 4 stars = Tier A 0.04 <= |edge| < 0.065, the sweet spot (248-153, hit 61.8% [57.1-66.5], ROI +17.6% [+8.6..+26.5], ROI-positive every season 2022-2026); 3 stars = 0.03-0.04 (234-177, hit 56.9% [52.4-61.6], ROI +8.7% [-0.0..+17.8]); 2 stars = the smallest playable edges, |edge| < 0.03 past the +EV gate (Tier B lives here — only 4 graded decided picks ever, thin history, lowest playable conviction). The +EV gate is the PLAYABLE boundary: a -EV row can NEVER be 2 stars or better. v3.3 DISPLAY (Leon, 2026-07-25): the full 1-5 scale — a top-~10%-of-playable-scores pick displays 5 stars; BH certification is the separate `certified` boolean (false everywhere — the champion is NOT BH-certified on the v4 sealed walk). CONVICTION FLOOR (Leon, 2026-07-08: stop pure price-chasing flip-flops): PLAYABLE additionally requires REAL MODEL DIVERGENCE — |our_prob − market_devig_prob| >= 0.01. A row that clears +EV purely on plus-money juice while the model essentially agrees with the fair number is a 1-star 'price-only edge — no model conviction' lean, never playable. PLAYABLE = +EV at the real per-side price AND model divergence >= 0.01. SCORE/STAR v3.2 (Leon, 2026-07-09: TRUE continuous percentile — fixes the v3.1 structural flaw where the score was quantized by absolute edge band first, so a 2-star-band pick scoring 2.00-2.99 could NEVER cross the frozen 3-star cutoff ~3.06 and the middle tier starved): score v3.2 = 2.0 + 3.0 * strength_percentile for PLAYABLE rows (2.00-4.99, continuous — no band quantization); strength = 0.5*pct_rank(|our_prob − market_devig_prob|) + 0.5*pct_rank(ev), ranks against the FROZEN season playable distribution (score_reference); strength_percentile = pct_rank of that blend against the frozen blend distribution. Non-playable (1*) rows: score = 1.99 * their percentile within the frozen NON-playable distribution (tail-inverted edge measure — deeper into the measured >=0.065 anti-signal scores lower; no price -> 0) — passes rank against each other, always < 2.0. BH-certified 5* rows score 5.0. Stars = floor bands of the score: 2.00-2.99 -> 2*, 3.00-3.99 -> 3*, 4.00-4.99 -> 4* (~ a third of the playable percentile each). The frozen season reference lives in v4/models/output/score_reference_v32.json (payload `score_reference`), recomputed only on the nightly replay regen, never per-day. The measured absolute-edge-band records quoted above are historical calibration context, not the star bands' definition — under v3.2 the tiers are relative conviction (thirds of the season playable strength percentile) and the by_star_tier records in the record block are the live measurement of what each band earns. STAR DISPLAY v3.3 (Leon, 2026-07-25): display stars = frozen percentile bands of that score over playable rows (top ~10% -> 5 stars, next ~25% -> 4, next ~35% -> 3, rest -> 2; v4/models/output/star_bands_v33.json). The 1-star PASS set, the +EV playable boundary (playable scores still clamp below 5.0) and featured (= highest score) are all unchanged; a non-playable row is never promoted and always scores < 2.0; `certified` (BH significance) is a separate boolean, false everywhere today.
model_notes: EXECUTION LAYER (Leon, 2026-07-09) — three price/staking gains, zero model changes: (1) MEDIAN-GATE / BEST-PRICE (the proven config) — the +EV gate evaluates at the MEDIAN de-vig per-side price at the pick's line (the strict entry the data proved), while every pick is priced and graded at the BEST executable per-side price at that same line (the payout gain). A row that clears the median gate gets the best-price payout; a row that only clears on best-book juice is NOT a pick. The median-gated set repriced at best ran +3.2% ROI on the 2026 backfill (41-35-1); the 21 gate-expansion picks that only cleared at best ran 6-9-2/-25% and are EXCLUDED. The median is carried per row as median_price + gate_price/gate_ev diagnostics. The exact 3-way season comparison (median / median_gate_best / best) lives at record.best_vs_median_2026. (2) PRICE-IMPROVEMENT FLAG — on UNLOCKED picks only, each intraday cycle compares the current best per-side price vs the price at pick time; when better, the row carries price_improved={now, was, book, ts}. The pick/side/line/price/stars stay frozen to their wall (the lock rules are absolute; locked rows are never touched) — only this executable-entry info updates, and grading still uses the stored price. (3) SUGGESTED STAKE — every playable pick carries suggested_units from a flat-fraction star ladder (4*=2.0, 3*=1.0, 2*=0.5; a display suggestion, NOT Kelly), and every record block carries units_weighted (the same picks tier-staked) next to the flat record — tier-weighting must keep proving itself or it is noise.

SCORE/STAR v3.2 (Leon, 2026-07-09): the continuous score is now a TRUE season percentile — 2.0 + 3.0 x the pick's strength percentile (0.5 x |divergence| rank + 0.5 x EV rank) within the frozen playable reference — and stars are plain floor bands of it (2.00-2.99/3.00-3.99/4.00-4.99 -> 2/3/4 stars, ~a third of the playable percentile each). Fixes the v3.1 structural flaw: the old score was quantized by absolute edge band BEFORE the percentile cutoffs, so a 2-star-band pick (score 2.00-2.99) could never cross the frozen 3-star cutoff (~3.06) — 3 stars was structurally starved. LOCKED rows keep their frozen pre-fix stamps (the lock rule is absolute); v3.2 applies to rows written/re-rendered from 2026-07-09 on. Non-playable rows rank among themselves at 0.00-1.99; the -EV floor, conviction floor, toxic-tail demotion and the 4-star ceiling are unchanged.

HARD LOCK + CONVICTION FLOOR (Leon, 2026-07-08): (1) picks HARD-LOCK at first pitch — once a game starts, its board rows are IMMUTABLE (the judged Vegas line/side/price/stars freeze at the last pre-start state; grading uses exactly that locked state; `locked_at` carries the freeze wall + timestamp). Each WALL row is also first-write-wins: once written it is never overwritten by a later cycle. (2) playable now requires REAL MODEL DIVERGENCE (|our_prob − market_devig_prob| >= 0.01) on top of +EV — micro-edges that only exist because of plus-money juice are 1-star 'price-only' leans. Both fixes answer the observed all-unders -> all-overs board flip between cycles: unstable price-driven micro-edges are no longer playable, and nothing re-writes after the freeze.

DEV-NULL (2026-07-07, v4/models/UNIFIED_TOTALS.md): the champion's edge does NOT reproduce when re-derived on the Odds-API 5-DP odds table — the champion-style path graded flat (+0.1% on 283 dev picks, 2022-25) and the V4 GBM residual path was actively anti-signal at high divergence (-16.6%). CHAMPION V2 therefore uses the champion's OWN pipeline (its snapshot stack + frozen model + frozen policy) as the pick source; V4 adds serving-time discipline (+EV gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers, nightly grading) — it does NOT re-derive the signal.

HABITAT EROSION WARNING: the champion's trigger habitat — cross-book totals dispersion — is structurally shrinking: T-3h line_std 0.126 (2023) -> 0.096 (2024) -> 0.083 (2025) -> 0.076 (2026); share of slates with >=2 distinct lines 67% -> 48% -> 43% -> 39%; books quoted 16.7 -> 11.7 -> 10.9 -> 11.0. Expect fewer qualifying picks over time. The record display is the ongoing proof either way — no edge is presumed.

STAR RECALIBRATION (2026-07-07, v4/serve/STAR_CALIBRATION.md): star tiers were re-fit to the champion's own measured 2022-2026 bucket win-rates (day-clustered CIs). The edge-ROI gradient is NOT monotone — it is an inverted U: 0.03-0.04 hit 56.9% ROI +8.7%; 0.04-0.065 hit 61.8% ROI +17.6%; >= 0.065 hit 43.4% ROI -17.1% (extreme divergence is where the champion is most WRONG, not most right; sweet-spot-vs-tail ROI gap +34.8pp, 95% CI +11.4..+58.1). Stars therefore peak at 0.04-0.065 and the >= 0.065 tail is demoted out of the playable tiers.

STAR SYSTEM v3.1 (2026-07-07, Leon: 'normalize all picks — I want to make sure we get some 4s'): playable stars re-tiered from absolute edge bands to NORMALIZED PERCENTILE BANDS of the unchanged continuous score (4* = top ~10% of playable scores season-wide, 3* = next ~25%, 2* = rest; cutoffs frozen from the season replay distribution, refreshed only on the nightly regen). Honest consequence: a star tier is now a RELATIVE conviction band, not a measured edge bucket — read the by_star_tier records for what each band actually earns. The -EV floor is hard (normalization never promotes a non-playable row); 1* passes, the toxic-tail demotion, the 4* ceiling and featured are unchanged.

STAR SYSTEM v3 (2026-07-07, same day, Leon): rate EVERY game — no empty cells. 1 star now MEANS 'we would pass' (the lean side+line is still shown); the toxic >= 0.065 tail is a 1-star PASS, no longer a bet, so the headline record is over the PLAYABLE (2-4 star) set. Tier B moved from a 1-star lean to 2 stars: it clears the +EV gate below 0.03 divergence — playable at the lowest conviction, on thin history (4 graded decided picks ever), not on proven skill. Every row carries a continuous 0-5 `score` (stars + within-band edge/EV blend) and the payloads expose per-day featured_game_id = the highest score of the day (playable first; all-pass days feature the best lean, flagged).

prob_calibration.recipe: logit(p_cal) = logit(p_mkt) + s * (logit(p_our) - logit(p_mkt)); s fit by penalized IRLS with identity prior s~N(1, 1/25), clamped to [0, 1.25]; NO intercept (the layer refuses to learn the trailing window's over/under rate); expanding-window walk-forward fit on the engine's own graded FG-totals rows (2026 replay pre-block + served graded ledger, y = final vs judged line, pushes/voids dropped, strictly date < D); refit per serve date, frozen first-fit-wins; inactive (identity) below 300 rows / 10 graded days
prob_calibration.scope: v4 model-grid FULL-GAME TOTALS our_prob only — champion-stream picks, spread/ML/F5 rows, the EV-gate math and every score/star band cutoff are untouched; they simply receive the calibrated probability
prob_calibration.note: SCORE BASIS CHANGE (activation-dated 2026-07-27, forward only): the model grid's served probability passes through a walk-forward market-anchored calibration map fitted on strictly-past graded picks before the (unchanged) EV gate and score pipeline. Locked picks, graded history and every past score/record are NEVER restated. A calibrated row can never flip sides — only its stated conviction changes. This does NOT create edge and no edge is claimed: it makes the confidence number mean what it says.

staking.basis: suggested_units is a FLAT-FRACTION LADDER by star tier (5*/4* = 2.0u — the top rung is shared until the tiers prove a 5* premium in the record tables, 3* = 1.0u, 2* = 0.5u; 1* rated-PASS rows get none; EXPANDED-band fills stake 0.5u REGARDLESS of display stars — the band's honesty rail) — a display suggestion, NOT Kelly and not bankroll-aware. Record blocks carry `units_weighted` (the same picks tier-staked) alongside the flat 1u record; the two are reported side by side so the tiering keeps proving (or disproving) itself — no edge is presumed.

price_improvement.note: price_improved={now, was, book, ts} appears on UNLOCKED playable rows whose CURRENT best per-side price at the pick's line beats the entry price ('price improved — now +112 at X'). headline_champion_v2.basis: Headline record = the CHAMPION V2 stream exactly: the PLAYABLE (2-4 star, star v3) champion picks — passed the +EV gate AND outside the measured >=0.065 anti-signal tail. EXECUTION LAYER (Leon, 2026-07-09 — the proven config): the +EV GATE evaluates at the MEDIAN de-vig per-side price at the pick's line (strict entry), while the served/graded per-side price is the BEST EXECUTABLE price at that same line (payout gain; the median is carried per row as median_price + gate_price/gate_ev diagnostics). A row playable only on best-book juice (fails the median gate) is NOT a pick: the median-gated set repriced at best ran +3.2% ROI (41-35-1) on the 2026 backfill, the 21 gate-expansion picks ran -25% and are EXCLUDED. record.best_vs_median_2026 carries the exact 3-way same-pick-set comparison (median / median_gate_best / best). HEADLINE DEDUP: the headline + per-tier + per-lead + per-source + per-month rollups count ONE result per (game x stream) — a game that emits multiple per-wall graded rows (reconstructed/live) counts once (the locked/latest-wall canonical); n_rows_dropped is disclosed in record.headline_dedup. 2026 backfill = rolling-origin stream (2026-03-27..06-10, Tier A, morning shopped/median per-side prices) + the live forward paper track (2026-07-02 onward, frozen morning price); gap 2026-06-11..07-01 not reconstructable (game DB frozen 06-13; forward track started 07-02) and is simply absent — nothing is interpolated. Live picks accrue nightly at the latest-snapshot best-book price they were served at (gated at the median). Every record block also carries units_weighted — the same picks staked by the star-tier ladder (see UNITS_BASIS) — next to the flat 1u record.

THE PRODUCT is median_gate_best: the +EV gate evaluates at the MEDIAN de-vig price (strict entry), the pick is priced + graded at the BEST executable price at its own line. `best` (gate-at-best) is shown only to expose the gate-expansion set it over-admits (~-25% ROI), which is excluded from the product.

best_vs_median_2026.read: the product record is median_gate_best (== same_pick_set_at_best): median-gated entry, best-price payout. Compare it to `median` (the pure payout gain) and to `best` (which adds the gate-expansion set the product REJECTS). All reported without adjustment, small-n and all — no edge is claimed.
best_vs_median_2026.fallback_note: rows where no stored same-line shopped quote >= median existed — those rows price at the median. The pick's line never moves (lock rule), so a shopped quote at a DIFFERENT line is never substituted
